# Provider Capability and Model Catalog

DeltaLLM currently declares **15 provider presets** and **68 curated model entries**. Capabilities come from the runtime provider registry; model entries come from the validated catalogs packaged with DeltaLLM.

A capability means DeltaLLM has an implementation path for that configured model mode. It does not mean every upstream model supports every parameter. Confirm model-specific limits with the provider and test the exact deployment before production.
